scope.root_cause_layer: calibration transport observability and execution control
scope.repair: Preserve a sanitized structured stdout/stderr failure envelope, classify transport failures, allow one shared bounded retry only for a transient transport classification, and attest distinct judge threads/workspaces before the exact candidate canary.

failure_envelope.persistence: public unscored canary run record only; no prompts, hidden fixtures, grader data, auth material, or chain-of-thought

bounded_retry_policy.scope: both public judge calibration batches share one retry budget
bounded_retry_policy.stop_rule: Any ineligible failure, exhausted shared retry, repeated failure, calibration mismatch, judge-isolation failure, candidate-boundary failure, or candidate-canary failure stops the run immediately. No improvised retry.

targeted_gate_order: judge-a grades all 6 public calibration anchors in one batch under the bounded retry policy
judge-b grades all 6 public calibration anchors in one batch under the remaining shared retry budget
judge isolation attests distinct non-null ephemeral thread and workspace identities plus tool-free transports
candidate filesystem-denial probe passes under the previously frozen boundary
exact unscored frozen candidate canary executes once with zero retry
stop with READY_FOR_SCORED_AUTHORIZATION only when every targeted gate passes; otherwise STOP

pre_run_budget.provider: Codex subscription with existing ChatGPT authentication
